title: Rental Property Service Contracts Benefit Limits Schedule
content:
Benefit limits of Rental Property Service Contracts. The aggregate limit is the total benefit per term across all units, items and allowances. Each item limit applies per dwelling unit per term; a limit of $0.00 means the item is not covered on that tier.

## Aggregate limit per term

| Tier | Aggregate term limit |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Appliance | $6000.00 |
| Bridgewell Rental Systems | $8000.00 |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo | $10000.00 |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus | $15000.00 |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo | $20000.00 |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus | $30000.00 |

## Per-unit, per-term item limits

| Item | Appliance | Systems | Combo | Combo Plus | Multi-Unit Combo | Multi-Unit Combo Plus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Heating system | $0.00 | $2500.00 | $2000.00 | $3500.00 | $2000.00 | $3500.00 |
| Cooling system | $0.00 | $2500.00 | $2000.00 | $3500.00 | $2000.00 | $3500.00 |
| Ductwork | $0.00 | $500.00 | $0.00 | $1000.00 | $0.00 | $1000.00 |
| Interior plumbing leaks and stoppages | $0.00 | $1500.00 | $1000.00 | $2000.00 | $1000.00 | $2000.00 |
| Water heater | $0.00 | $1500.00 | $1000.00 | $2000.00 | $1000.00 | $2000.00 |
| Electrical system | $0.00 | $1500.00 | $1000.00 | $2000.00 | $1000.00 | $2000.00 |
| Each kitchen appliance | $1500.00 | $0.00 | $1000.00 | $2000.00 | $1000.00 | $2000.00 |
| Each laundry appliance | $1000.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $1500.00 | $0.00 | $1500.00 |
| Garage door opener | $400.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $500.00 | $0.00 | $500.00 |

(Column headings abbreviate the tier names Bridgewell Rental Appliance, Bridgewell Rental Systems, Bridgewell Rental Combo, Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus, Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo and Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus.)

## Reading the schedule

- On Bridgewell Rental Systems the kitchen appliance shows $0.00: kitchen appliances are not covered on that tier.
- On a three-unit building under Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo, each unit's water heater has its own $1000.00 limit for the term, while all payments on the contract share the one $20000.00 aggregate limit.
